description: Horizontal layout primitive for grouped inline items such as button rows, badge lists, and toolbars. Wraps when space runs out.

gap.description: Spacing between items, from the intent spacing scale.

grow.description: Makes the cluster fill its row. Needed for justify to have any effect inside a flex parent such as a card or dialog footer, where the cluster is otherwise sized to its content.

default.description: Inline items to group, typically buttons, badges, or avatars.

handled: Purely presentational: adds no role and no tab stop, so grouped controls keep their own semantics and focus order.
Items wrap rather than overflow, so grouped actions stay reachable at narrow widths.

required.when: the cluster is a toolbar of related controls
required.requirement: Add role="toolbar" and an aria-label on the cluster; it is presentational by default.

counterExamples.reason: justify="space-between" is not valid. Use justify="between".
A row of actions belongs in aihio-cluster. aihio-stack stacks them vertically and stretches them to full width.
justify="end" does nothing here: the cluster is a content-sized flex item inside the footer. Add grow so it fills the row.

examples.title: Form actions at the end of a row
In a card footer
examples.description: A cluster in a footer has to grow to fill the row before justify has room to act.
examples.markup:
<aihio-card>
  <form>
    <aihio-card-content>
      <aihio-field>
        <label slot="label">Project name</label>
        <aihio-input name="project" value="Aihio"></aihio-input>
      </aihio-field>
    </aihio-card-content>
    <aihio-card-footer>
      <aihio-cluster grow justify="end">
        <aihio-button variant="outline" type="reset">Reset</aihio-button>
        <aihio-button type="submit">Save</aihio-button>
      </aihio-cluster>
    </aihio-card-footer>
  </form>
</aihio-card>
